brief:
Armed Israeli settlers stormed the village of At-Tuwani in Masafer Yatta, south of Hebron, Eye on Palestine reported. The settlers opened fire on Palestinian residents during the evening incursion.

Masafer Yatta, in the southern West Bank, has been a flashpoint for settler violence and displacement efforts. At-Tuwani and surrounding communities in the area have faced repeated attacks and pressure from Israeli settlers in recent years.
dek: Armed Israeli settlers stormed the village of At-Tuwani in Masafer Yatta, south of Hebron, this evening, opening fire on Palestinian residents.
title: Armed Israeli settlers open fire on Palestinians in At-Tuwani
